title: Q&A with Signal's Moxie Marlinspike on AI and cryptography, his privacy-focused AI chat service Confer, surveilling AI models rather than users, and more (Tyler Cowen/Conversations with Tyler)
summary: Tyler Cowen / Conversations with Tyler: Q&A with Signal's Moxie Marlinspike on AI and cryptography, his privacy-focused AI chat service Confer, surveilling AI models rather than users, and more — Moxie Marlinspike built Signal and designed the encryption protocol underneath it — the same protocol that also secures WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Skype.
